bun:test (1.3.13) compat catalog — the vitest→bun:test migration is COMPLETE (see [[project.bunMigrationScope]]); keep this as the reference for writing/porting tests.

BUN AUTO-HANDLES (no rewrite needed): vi.mock(path, factory) — recognized as mock.module with effective hoisting; vi.fn / vi.spyOn / vi.clearAllMocks / basic Mock typing; vitest-style globals (describe/it/test/expect/before*/after*). `vi` is NOT a global but bun's parser recognizes the call shapes in source.

BUN DOES NOT IMPLEMENT (the real porting cost): vi.resetModules — rewrite per-callsite or re-call mock.module(...); vi.mocked(x) → (x as Mock); vi.mock(path, async (importOriginal) => ...) callback form → call await import(path) inside the factory (bun's factory gets no importOriginal arg); vi.hoisted → plain IIFE const (no transformer hoisting); vi.importActual → await import(path) (bun doesn't auto-mock, the real module is just the import).

ISOLATION: bun:test does NOT isolate module cache per file (vitest does by default). --isolate is MANDATORY — 357 pass without vs 1392 with — and lives in the package.json test script because bunfig.toml cannot express it as a TOML key.

SPAWN ENV GOTCHA (2026-06-09, #130): Bun's child_process does NOT pass runtime process.env mutations to children when `env` is omitted — the child gets the original shell environ, so _setup.ts's RVR_DATA_DIR mutation never reaches env-less spawns (Node passes mutations; this silently regressed in the migration and leaked 515 telemetry rows). Always pass env: { ...process.env, ... } explicitly in spawn tests; helpers/spawnGuard.ts fails a suite whose dist ignores RVR_DATA_DIR.
